feedback.metadata.description-tell-us-wh: Tell us what would help your prayer and your visit - suggestions, corrections, or a word of encouragement. Every message is read by a person.

feedback.header.our-lady-of-lebanon-at-h: Our Lady of Lebanon at Harissa
feedback.tell-us-what-would-help.this-si: This site exists for your prayer. If something helped you, something is broken, or something is missing - a guide you wished for, a correction we should make, a prayer you could not find - write it here. Every message is read by a person, and the ones that can improve the site become real tasks on our work board.
feedback.tell-us-what-would-help.your-me: Your message stays private. We may use it to improve the site, but we never publish your words or your name.
feedback.tell-us-what-would-help.what-ki: What kind of feedback is this?
feedback.tell-us-what-would-help.a-sugge: A suggestion - something to add or change
feedback.tell-us-what-would-help.a-quest: A question about the faith or the site
feedback.tell-us-what-would-help.write-i: Write it simply, the way you would tell a friend.
feedback.tell-us-what-would-help.between: Between 10 and 2,000 characters. Please do not include medical records, passwords, or other sensitive information.
feedback.tell-us-what-would-help.a-first: A first name is plenty. Leave it empty to stay anonymous.
feedback.tell-us-what-would-help.email-o: Email (optional - only if you want a reply)
feedback.tell-us-what-would-help.used-on: Used only to answer you. Never shared, never added to a list.
feedback.human-verification.complete-the: Complete the security check, then send your feedback.
feedback.footer.reader-feedback-human-re: Reader feedback, human-reviewed. Author: Please pray for the person who made this website.
